_note: Data sources used by the original claude.ai dashboard. Each 'call' source was an MCP connector call made from the reader's browser. In the website, each becomes a server-side API route that calls the vendor's REST API with credentials from .env. '{{name}}' is a filter value filled in by the page (validated with the regex in 'rules').

projects.title: Zoho projects
projects.description: Every project in the Hanini Zoho Projects portal with its status, group, owner, progress and open and closed task counts.

projectTasks.title: Open tasks in the clicked project
projectTasks.description: Every open task in the project picked from the project icons, from Zoho Projects.

projectHours.title: Logged hours on the selected project's tasks
projectHours.description: Every task of the clicked project from Zoho Projects, with its logged hours and owners (all pages).

projectPhases.title: Phases of the clicked project
projectPhases.description: Phases (milestones) used by the clicked project's tasks; then get_phase_details for each, giving owner, status, status color and dates.

crmContacts.title: Zoho CRM contact search
crmContacts.description: Zoho CRM contacts matching the name typed in the Overview contact picker.

projectRoster.title: Project team roster
projectRoster.description: Roles by Tier 1 and Tier 2 with level, firm and contact details, from the Roster tab of the Project Team Roster Google Sheet. The page also WRITES to this tab (edit cells, append rows, delete rows).

agendaNotes.title: Agenda notes by project and week
agendaNotes.description: Last week, This week and Upcoming notes for each agenda item, by project and ISO week (e.g. 2026-W48), from the Agenda tab of the same Google Sheet. Columns: Project, Week, Section, Item, Last week, This week, Upcoming, Source.

meetings.title: Gemini meeting notes for the selected project
meetings.description: Google Drive docs titled 'Notes by Gemini' whose title contains the selected project's building number or name, newest first.

args.query: title contains 'Notes by Gemini' and title contains '{{bldg}}'

meetings.websiteNote: Drive API v3: files.list with q="name contains 'Notes by Gemini' and name contains '<bldg>'". The connector also returned a text snippet; with the plain API, export the doc as text (files.export mimeType=text/plain) and parse the Summary and Next steps sections.

qbSales.title: QuickBooks sales by customer and project
qbSales.description: All-time sales for each customer and project (sub-customer) in the UrbanCore Builders LLC QuickBooks company.
qbSales.websiteNote: QuickBooks Online Reports API: GET /v3/company/<realmId>/reports/CustomerSales (all dates). Returns JSON rows, so the markdown-table parsing in data-loaders.js is no longer needed.

qbAR.title: QuickBooks open receivables by customer and project
qbAR.description: Open A/R balance by aging bucket for each customer and project, as of today.

appfolioSpend.title: AppFolio spend by property
appfolioSpend.description: Bill amounts per AppFolio property (with street and city), all-time and for 2026 to date, paid and unpaid. Fields used: property_id, property, street, city, bldg_num, street_abbr, bills_to_date, spent_to_date, bills_ytd, spend_ytd.
appfolioSpend.websiteNote: Static snapshot. Put a fresh export in data/appfolio_spend.json (not included in this bundle).

appfolioLoans.title: AppFolio loans
appfolioLoans.description: Active loans by property from AppFolio's loan register. Fields used: loan_id, lender, street, bldg_num, street_abbr, balance, interest_rate, monthly_payment, maturity_date.
appfolioLoans.websiteNote: Static snapshot. Put a fresh export in data/appfolio_loans.json (not included in this bundle).

hoursByPerson.title: Hours by person (estimate)
hoursByPerson.description: Computed from projectHours: logged task hours per person, with each shared task's hours split evenly between its owners. See data-loaders.js.
